# Alarm Investigation for Site S-SUD-004

- **Classification:** no_impact
- **Root cause:** no_impact at `S-SUD-004`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct alarm logs show transient self-clearing warnings and minor alarms, KPIs remain normal with 100% availability, and maintenance/changes/external events have been checked and ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-27 09:13 to 2026-09-27 11:00
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-27 09:13
- **Affected:** S-SUD-004

## Summary

Transient environmental or hardware noise causing self-clearing warnings and minor alarms without operational impact.

No operational impact observed; site availability remained at 100% and traffic volume and drop rates showed no sustained deviation from baseline.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-27 06:00: Window start for alarm investigation on S-SUD-004 [T3]
- 2026-09-27 09:13: First occurrence of TEMP_HIGH warning on S-SUD-004 [ALM-000595, T3]
- 2026-09-27 09:14: First occurrence of VSWR_HIGH minor alarm on S-SUD-004 [ALM-000596, T3]
- 2026-09-27 10:02: Last of the transient TEMP_HIGH and VSWR_HIGH alarms cleared on S-SUD-004 [ALM-000595, ALM-000596, T3]
- 2026-09-27 10:15: Slight active users dip below baseline observed on S-SUD-004 [T4]
- 2026-09-27 11:00: Recovery of active users deviation observed [T4]

## Evidence

- No detector alerts were triggered for S-SUD-004 between 2026-09-27 04:00 and 2026-09-28 09:11. [T1]
- 21 alarms occurred on S-SUD-004 and associated entities consisting of 9 minor and 12 warning alerts, all of which self-cleared within 10 minutes and none were active at asked_at. [T3, ALM-000595, ALM-000596]
- Availability remained at 100% with no sustained deviations in DL volume or drop rate, while active users showed a very minor dip around 10:15 against a thin baseline. [T4]
- No maintenance windows, changes, or external events were scheduled or performed on S-SUD-004 or its parents during the window. [T5, T6, T7]
- Sibling site S-SUD-007 reported zero alarms during the window. [T8]

## Hypotheses

1. **no_impact** at S-SUD-004: confirmed. Alarms were transient, self-clearing minor/warning events, and KPI metrics showed no operational impact or service degradation. [T3, T4]
2. **transport_failure** at LNK-SUD-02-A: rejected. No critical or major alarms were logged on the link or related ancestor paths, and parent/sibling nodes operated normally. [T2, T3, T8]
3. **bad_change** at S-SUD-004: rejected. Change management logs confirmed zero changes were executed during the specified timeframe. [T6]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000595: TEMP_HIGH warnings were minor/warning level and self-clearing within minutes, resulting in zero service downtime.
- ALM-000596: VSWR_HIGH minor alarms were self-clearing and did not correlate with any degradation in availability or traffic volume.

## Recommended actions

- No action required; alarms were self-clearing with no customer impact.
